mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the GDP has increased for two consecutive quarters, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to increase.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals a broad-based demand expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer and construction sectors drive economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between HOUST and RSAFS increases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in the last month signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% within the last month signals easing inflationary pressures, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real income and purchasing power increase.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL decreases and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as both demand and labor market conditions improve.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both trigger conditions are met, or if the joint correlation between GDPC1 increases, UNRATE decreases, and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
